sec.title: August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 427)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio and early variety hours, Ed Wynn's legendary *Fire Chief* broadcast for Texaco (1932), Gertrude Berg's domestic humor on *The Goldbergs* for Duz (1943), John Larkin defending an estranged daughter on *Perry Mason* (1954), desert suspense on *A Voice in the Night* (1946), Rudy Vallee's *Fleischmann's Yeast Hour* with Elsie Mae Gordon and Jeanne Aubert (1934), and Jan Garber on *Treasury Star Parade* (1932–1954):
